title: The Bridge, the Budget, and the Bus Lane
instructions: 阅读一篇关于城市交通基础设施取舍的模拟教学材料（非官方雅思试题，非真实研究）。先通读全文，理解大意；再完成10道阅读题（单选、填空、匹配、判断）。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。之后学习语法：被动语态、因果表达、分词作定语的基础辨认。语法部分有8道独立新句练习。最后完成口语和写作迁移任务。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。
passage:
A city council in the town of Riverton met on Tuesday to discuss a major transport problem. The old North Bridge, which carries about 20,000 vehicles every day, is narrow and in poor condition. Engineers say it must be repaired or replaced within five years. The council has two main options, and each one has serious costs and benefits. This is a difficult trade-off between cost, time, and the environment.

Option A is to repair the existing bridge. This would cost about £8 million and take 18 months. During the work, the bridge would be closed to cars, and traffic would be sent through the town centre. Local shop owners are worried because customers might avoid the area. However, the repair would keep the bridge in its current location, so bus routes would not change. The council's transport officer, Maria Chen, said, "If we repair the bridge, we can keep the bus lane open. That means people who do not drive can still travel easily." Repairing the bridge would also mean less disruption to the existing road infrastructure, because no new roads would need to be built.

Option B is to build a new bridge 500 metres downstream. This would cost £22 million and take three years. The new bridge would have four lanes, a separate bus lane, and a wide path for bicycles and pedestrians. Because it would be built away from the town centre, traffic would not pass through local streets. But the new bridge would require a new road, and some green space would be lost. A local environmental group, Green Riverton, has opposed the plan. Its chair, David Okafor, argued, "The new road would cut through a park that is used by families every weekend. We should not destroy green space for cars." The group believes that building new infrastructure for cars goes against the town's environmental goals.

The council also considered a third idea: a temporary ferry service during the repair work. This was rejected because it would cost £3 million and carry only 500 people per day. The council will vote next month. Maria Chen added, "We need to think about the long term. A repaired bridge is cheaper now, but a new bridge may serve the town better in 30 years." The decision is not easy, and both sides have strong arguments. Some residents support the repair because it is cheaper and faster, while others oppose it because of traffic problems in the town centre. In the end, the council must weigh the short-term costs against the long-term needs of the town.

questions.explanation: 原文第一段明确说“carries about 20,000 vehicles every day”。

questions.evidence: Option A is to repair the existing bridge. This would cost about £8 million and take 18 months.

Because the new bridge will be too expensive.
Because the bus lane will be removed.
Because the park will be destroyed.
answers: Because the bridge will be closed to cars and customers might avoid the area.

questions.explanation: 原文说“carry only 500 people per day”。
questions.evidence: This was rejected because it would cost £3 million and carry only 500 people per day.

grammar.title: 被动语态、因果表达与分词作定语的基础辨认
grammar.explanation: 本课重点有三：1) 被动语态：当主语是动作的承受者时，用 be + 过去分词。例如“The bridge would be closed”表示桥被关闭。2) 因果表达：用 because, so, that means, therefore 等连接原因和结果。例如“Local shop owners are worried because customers might avoid the area.” 3) 分词作定语：单个分词放在名词前，或分词短语放在名词后，起形容词作用。例如“the existing bridge”（现有的桥），“people who do not drive”（不开车的人，这是定语从句，不是分词，但可对比理解）。注意区分新学形式与复习：被动语态和因果表达是新学重点；分词作定语只需基础辨认，不要求复杂分析。
grammar.example: During the work, the bridge would be closed to cars, and traffic would be sent through the town centre.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The new road ______ through the park last year.
questions.explanation: 主语road是build的承受者，且时间是last year，用一般过去时被动 was built。
questions.evidence: The new road would cut through a park that is used by families every weekend.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The ferry service ______ by the council next month.
questions.explanation: ferry service是review的承受者，next month表示将来，用 will be reviewed。
questions.evidence: The council will vote next month.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct causal connector: The bridge is narrow. ______, it must be repaired.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系：桥窄，因此必须修。Therefore表示结果。
questions.evidence: Engineers say it must be repaired or replaced within five years.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct causal connector: ______ the new road would destroy green space, the environmental group opposes it.
questions.explanation: 前后是原因—结果关系，Because引导原因。
questions.evidence: We should not destroy green space for cars.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle used as an adjective: The ______ bridge is cheaper to repair.
questions.explanation: existing是现在分词作定语，修饰bridge，表示“现有的”。
questions.evidence: Option A is to repair the existing bridge.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: Bus routes ______ if the bridge is repaired.
questions.explanation: bus routes是change的承受者，条件句主句用将来时被动 will not be changed。
questions.evidence: However, the repair would keep the bridge in its current location, so bus routes would not change.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct causal expression: The ferry was rejected ______ it could carry only 500 people per day.
questions.evidence: This was rejected because it would cost £3 million and carry only 500 people per day.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle used as an adjective: The ______ cost is about £8 million.
questions.explanation: estimated是过去分词作定语，表示“估计的”。
questions.evidence: This would cost about £8 million and take 18 months.
